string.text: Draw a distortion over just the FACE of every humanoid in range, alive or dead. Fully passive: no need to aim at or identify anyone. The box sits over the front of the head. Requires the custom bodycam engine build; inert without it.
How a face is redacted: a pixelated (mosaic) censor, or a solid black box.
Extra margin around the face box, as a fraction of its size (0 = tight on the face, 0.15 = 15% larger each side).
How far face redaction reaches. A distant face still stops once its box is under about a pixel on screen.
Master intensity of the redaction effect.
Also draw the redaction inside a PiP scope's lens. The main view is unaffected either way.
Hide in main view while aiming
While aiming down sight, suppress the main-view redaction for a clean sight picture. In-scope redaction (if enabled) still draws.
Log a line to the console whenever redaction switches on or off, with the number of face boxes being submitted.
